title: Small controls drawn over radios, toggle buttons, a password field and checkboxes
blurb: Five small controls from the ui-feed collection, rebuilt around native elements: a carousel of typefaces on a radio group, a bold, italic and underline toolbar with a tooltip, an avatar button that comes back online, a password field whose dots pop in, and a list of newsletters that turn italic when chosen.
question: Can the canvas give a small control its motion while the native element underneath keeps its keys, its state and what it says to a screen reader?
result: Yes for all five in the test browser. The radios, toggle buttons, password field and checkboxes kept their keys and form values while the canvas squeezed cards, popped dots and crossfaded rows. All five took taps on an emulated phone and stopped painting at rest. Nothing here is verified on a phone.
